findings.evidence_search_query: CZOO Cazoo May 21 2024 subsidiaries administration Teneo SEC

findings.detection_rule: SEC exact suspension-date and event-time NYSE ticker recovery
findings.detection_value: NYSE immediately suspended CZOO, commenced delisting proceedings and the issuer did not appeal
findings.required_evidence: NYSE determination, exact suspension time, event-time ticker, appeal decision, OTC transition and final delisting date
findings.evidence_search_query: CZOO Cazoo May 21 2024 NYSE immediate suspension OTC Pink SEC

findings.detection_rule: SEC proxy retrospective final-delisting effective-date recovery
findings.detection_value: Class A ordinary shares were delisted from NYSE effective June 3 and continued on OTC Pink
findings.required_evidence: final delisting effective date, suspended NYSE security identity, OTC continuation and later winding-up status
findings.evidence_search_query: CZOO Cazoo June 3 2024 final NYSE delisting SEC proxy

findings.detection_rule: SEC shareholder-approved parent winding-up event separated from subsidiary administration and final dissolution
findings.detection_value: Cayman parent entered voluntary winding up because unable to pay debts; liquidators were appointed, transfers closed and no shareholder proceeds were expected
findings.required_evidence: shareholder resolution, insolvency basis, liquidator appointment, transfer-book closure, asset realization, court supervision, final dissolution and explicit old-share cancellation or distribution
findings.evidence_search_query: CZOOF Cazoo July 2 2024 voluntary winding up unable to pay debts liquidators SEC
